_format: This is docs/.solo-config.example.json — illustrative only. The framework reads docs/.solo-config.json, not this file. Copy whichever pass_set_capture_command matches your test runner into docs/.solo-config.json's invariance.pass_set_capture_command field. Per D3.3 §Refactor-spike invariance predicate.
_caveat: The pass_set_capture_command must produce one stable test ID per line on stdout and exit zero. Verify the chosen command on your runner before sealing a refactor-spike spec — a malformed command halts §invariance-config-missing at /verify time. Production-quality runner-agnostic variants using structured output (--json-report for pytest, --json for jest, --format json for cargo) are documented in D3.3 §Runner-agnostic capture mechanism; recommended for refactor-spike specs that ship to other consumers.

_examples_per_runner._pytest_comment: Python; assumes default pytest output. Caveat: pytest -q does not always emit per-test PASSED lines. The D3.3 §Runner-agnostic capture mechanism alternative uses pytest-json-report with --json-report-file=/dev/stdout.
_examples_per_runner.vitest: pnpm vitest run --reporter=json | jq -r '.testResults[].assertionResults[] | select(.status=="passed") | .fullName' | sort
_examples_per_runner._jest_comment: Node/JavaScript; illustrative — verify command produces one passing-test ID per line. D3.3 §Runner-agnostic capture mechanism alternative uses jest --json --silent piped through jq.
_examples_per_runner._go_test_comment: Go; standard library test runner. Produces lines like '--- PASS: TestName (0.00s)' as test IDs.
_examples_per_runner._cargo_test_comment: Rust; illustrative — verify command produces one passing-test ID per line. D3.3 §Runner-agnostic capture mechanism alternative uses cargo test -- -Z unstable-options --format json piped through jq.

_target_config_shape: After choosing one of the above runner examples, your docs/.solo-config.json should contain (at least) the following blocks alongside whatever marker / cascade / workflow keys it already carries:

workflow._default_strategy_comment: Optional. Empty string means no product-level default; /specify step 1 falls back to first-principles proposal. Set to one of: walking-skeleton, api-boundary, capability-cluster, refactor-spike, hybrid. Behavioral wiring deferred to Child 0001-B per parent spec Open Question 4 — this slot ships in v0.2 but /onboard does not yet write it and /specify does not yet read it.
